question: A multiple disc clutch is used to operate the speed regulating gears of a lathe. If the torque delivered by the clutch is 400 lbs.-in., evaluate the number of discs necessary and the force acting on them while the clutch is in operation. Assume a factor of safety of 2 and limit the disc friction surface sizes between 5 in. and 3 in.

options.A: Three discs, Force on the discs = 1028 lbs.
options.B: Four discs, Force on the discs = 1200 lbs.
options.C: Two discs, Force on the discs = 1600 lbs.
options.D: Four discs, Force on the discs = 800 lbs.
options.E: Six discs, Force on the discs = 666.7 lbs.
options.F: Two discs, Force on the discs = 1256.6 lbs.
options.G: One disc, Force on the discs = 2000 lbs.
options.H: Seven discs, Force on the discs = 571.4 lbs.
options.I: Five discs, Force on the discs = 1600 lbs.
options.J: Eight discs, Force on the discs = 500 lbs.
